apps.scope.label: Current application
apps.scope.required: Select an application before managing its data.
apps.feedback.load_error: Could not load App management data. Try again.
apps.feedback.save_error: Could not save the change. Try again.
apps.feedback.validation_error: Check and correct the form fields.
apps.application.title: Application management
apps.application.description: Create and configure independent mobile application boundaries for the current workspace.
apps.application.columns.name: Application
apps.application.fields.name: Application name
apps.users.title: App user management
apps.users.description: Only people explicitly associated with the current application are listed; shared account infrastructure still owns identity.
apps.users.fields.password_hint: At least 12 characters; it is never shown again after saving.
apps.users.password_reset.title: Reset App user password
apps.users.password_reset.description: Set a new sign-in password for “{name}”. The server applies its security policy to existing mobile sessions.
apps.users.confirm.enable.title: Enable this user?
apps.users.confirm.enable.description: This allows “{name}” to use the current application.
apps.users.confirm.disable.title: Disable this user?
apps.users.confirm.disable.description: This blocks “{name}” from using the current application.
apps.users.confirm.unlock.title: Unlock this user?
apps.users.confirm.unlock.description: This clears the sign-in lock on “{name}” .
apps.users.confirm.reset-password.title: Reset this user's password?
apps.users.confirm.reset-password.descri: This starts a secure password reset flow for “{name}” .
apps.users.confirm.revoke-sessions.title: Revoke mobile sessions?
apps.users.confirm.revoke-sessions.descr: The current application's mobile sessions for “{name}” become invalid immediately.
apps.pages.title: Single pages
apps.pages.description: Maintain bilingual drafts, publishing, and revision history for legal, About, and custom pages.
apps.pages.reserved_hint: A core page identifier cannot be changed or deleted.
apps.pages.columns.title: Title
apps.pages.fields.title: Title
apps.pages.fields.blocks_hint: Only heading, paragraph, quote, code, image, list, and divider blocks are supported.
apps.pages.delete.title: Delete this single page?
apps.pages.delete.description: This deletes “{name}” and its draft content; published revisions remain server-audited.
